# The packages CI installs for tests/run_offline.py, and the documented local install (docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).
# Hash-pinned, binary only, no dependency resolution: pip runs --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps,
# so this file plus the lock it includes must name the complete set.
# D-8a (owner, 2026-10-14): PyYAML for the G1 compose-declaration and bypass-path tests.
# D-8b (owner, 2026-10-26, AVR-757): the web and connector test dependencies, so the UI harness registry,
# the Audible pages and the avrana-home web suite run instead of failing or skipping.
# Hashes are for CPython 3.12 on Linux x86_64. Every wheel added by D-8b is pure Python (py3-none-any),
# so its hash holds on every platform; PyYAML and the lock's pydantic-core and markupsafe are
# platform wheels. Hashes checked against PyPI on the date in each comment.

# PyYAML 6.0.2, CPython 3.12, manylinux x86_64 wheel; hash checked against PyPI on 2026-10-14.

# lock rather than pinned twice. The path is relative to this file.
-r ../services/avrana-home/requirements.lock
